args.description: Arguments that call must have (a subset; strings compare case- and space-insensitively).
args.title: Args

name.description: Tool that must be proposed at least once.
name.title: Name

answer_forbid.description: Phrases the summary must not contain.
answer_forbid.title: Answer Forbid

answer_has.description: Groups of phrases for the duty manager's summary: every group must match, any phrase in a group will do.
answer_has.title: Answer Has

max_steps.description: Most model calls a correct run needs.
max_steps.title: Max Steps

max_tool_calls.description: Most tool calls a correct run needs.
max_tool_calls.title: Max Tool Calls

max_total_tokens.description: Token ceiling for the whole run.
max_total_tokens.title: Max Total Tokens

message_forbid.description: Phrases no proposed passenger message may contain (e.g. a canary).
message_forbid.title: Message Forbid

notify.description: The one message that must be sent, or null: nobody may be notified.

tools_forbidden.description: Tools that must never be proposed.
tools_forbidden.title: Tools Forbidden

vouchers.description: Exactly the vouchers that must be ISSUED (empty: none).
vouchers.title: Vouchers

writes_only_for.description: If set, every proposed write must be for this flight.
writes_only_for.title: Writes Only For

by.description: Who labelled the case (a person or a role). Empty means unlabelled.
by.title: By

why.description: Why the expected behaviour is right, in a sentence a reviewer can check.
why.title: Why

NotifyExpect.description: Exactly one passenger message must be SENT, for this flight, with this reason.

flight.description: Flight whose passengers are told, e.g. ZZ173.
flight.title: Flight

mention.description: Phrases the sent message must contain (case-insensitive), e.g. the new time.
mention.title: Mention

reason.description: The notify_passengers reason the sent message must carry.
reason.title: Reason

NotifyExpect.title: NotifyExpect

description: One golden case for the disruption handler.

flight.description: The flight the notice is about, as written in it (may be unknown or another carrier's).
flight.title: Flight

id.description: n.. normal, e.. edge, a.. adversarial; stable forever.
id.title: Id

notice.description: The ops notice exactly as the handler receives it.
notice.title: Notice

request.description: The duty manager's request, if any.
request.title: Request

source.description: Where it came from: s01-notice-<n> (Section 1's notices) or synthetic.
source.title: Source

tags.description: Free tags for slicing, e.g. delay, mismatch, injection, spec:mismatch.
tags.title: Tags
